title: StudySession
description: YAML front matter of course/units/NN-slug/sessions/NN-slug.md. The ~25-minute at-home unit (D-012). THIS IS THE METHODOLOGY CONTRACT (D-011) — downstream agents consume `goals`, never the methodology that produced them.

accepted.description: The teacher's deliberate exceptions for THIS file (D-037). Each entry suppresses one validation rule's findings for this file; `classkit validate` still counts them, so they are never invisible. Only the teacher adds these — an agent never does so on its own.

rule.description: The rule code, as `classkit validate` prints it in brackets, e.g. 'session_path_feasibility'.

reason.description: Why the departure is deliberate, e.g. 'long session on purpose — exam week'.

goals.description: Session goals. Under question-driven-25 these are 3-5 Guiding Questions. Other methodologies emit other item types — hence `type`.

id.description: e.g. 'U01-S02-G1'. THE atomic addressable unit — referenced by activities, assessment items and the Gem.

type.description: question-driven-25 emits only 'question'. Other methodologies may emit the rest.

prompt.description: The guiding question, phrased as a question the student should be able to answer. For non-question types, the task statement.

objectives.description: Unit Objectives this goal rolls up to.

paths.description: Candidate routes to the answer. None is mandatory — the student chooses (D-010).

ref.description: URL, or a textbook key with locator, e.g. 'CLRS ch.3 pp.45-52'.

est_minutes.description: Estimated time. If omitted, derived from defaults/time-constants.yaml.
